episodes.title: Daniella Mestyanek Young and Paula Dozsa on You're Probably in a Cult
episodes.description:
Most of us think we know what a cult looks like: a charismatic leader, an isolated compound, strange beliefs, and people who failed to see the warning signs. In The Culting of America: What Makes a Cult and Why We Love Them, Daniella Mestyanek Young argues that “cultiness” exists on a spectrum. The same forces that make extreme groups powerful can also appear in institutions we consider completely normal.

Daniella joined host Paula for a salon with an unusual shared starting point: both were raised in the Children of God, a religious cult. Daniella escaped at age 15, put herself through high school, and graduated as college valedictorian before commissioning into the US Army as an intelligence officer.

We discussed what growing up in a cult can teach us to notice elsewhere—in workplaces, political movements, wellness communities, fandoms, religious institutions, the military, and even groups of friends. We also explored how we can preserve connection and belonging without surrendering too much of ourselves.

Whether participants had read The Culting of America, escaped a cult of their own, wondered why intelligent people can believe extraordinary things, or simply caught themselves thinking my group would never do that, the conversation invited all to reflect on the dynamics of belonging and influence.
